hypothesis: A resolver-certified direction market may retain a small residual when the current Chainlink price is farther from the opening boundary than the frozen pre-cutoff 99.5th percentile absolute Chainlink move remaining to expiry, and the Wilson lower probability bound still exceeds the executable ask after doubled fees and one tick.

frozen_mechanics.fair_value: max(current executable quote midpoint, Wilson lower bound of the frozen empirical central-tail probability)
frozen_mechanics.entry_inequality: fair lower bound - executable ask - 2x dynamic crypto taker fees - one token tick > 0
frozen_mechanics.execution: 250ms event-tape quote survival; <=20% displayed touch; max $10 notional
frozen_mechanics.exit: terminal resolution; no interim mark-price stop

selection_disclosure: H43 was selected after a small positive discovery cohort. H43-X is a new rule and identity; every pre-manifest H43/H43-X row is excluded and the model cannot use observations after the fixed cutoff.
decision_rule: After at least 300 fresh independent markets and 14 calendar days, require positive doubled-cost PnL in both chronological halves, market/day-clustered lower confidence bounds above zero, family-wise multiple-testing correction, no dominant asset/day, and positive latency replays at 100/250/500ms.
zero_edge_disclosure: The strategy is allowed to produce no orders or approximately zero edge; missing model data is not permission to substitute Gaussian Phi or tune the tail.
